crossRefs.note: Their wings were joined to one another. They didn’t turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.
Each one went straight forward: where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.

translations.web: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn when they went.
translations.bsb: As they moved, they went in any of the four directions, without pivoting as they moved.
translations.kjv: When they went, they went upon their four sides: and they turned not when they went.
translations.asv: When they went, they went in their four directions: they turned not when they went.
